jobs.prompt: Ticket T-8026: after `swarm change "REASON" [FILE] --yes` (cmdChange in tools/scope-commands.mjs ~2559) records a change order that leaves requirements with no tickets (pendingRequirements), it currently prints manual steps (swarm scope split, run it, then --ingest RUN --merge). Make it automatic: when --yes is given and pending requirements exist, build the split manifest for exactly those requirements (the same buildSplitManifest/changeContext path cmdSplit uses), run it through the injectable deps.runSplit (the same default T-8024 added: runManifestChecked + wait), then ingest it with --merge through the same repair loop (respect --max-repairs N, default 3; add --no-split to keep the old manual behavior), and print the repair rounds, ingested tickets and parked tickets with their retry command. A ticket that never validates is parked as a named journal blocker; good tickets are ingested; never refuse the whole change order for ticket-level errors. Refactor so cmdSplit's ingest and this path share one function (no duplicated ingest code). Tests in a NEW tests/change-order-auto-split.test.mjs (reuse the fakeRun/gitRepo helper pattern from tests/scope-split-repair-loop.test.mjs): a change order adding a new requirement with an injected runSplit fake worker ends with that requirement's tickets in the ledger (no manual command); a fake worker returning a bad ticket that never validates parks it as a blocker while the good ones are ingested; --no-split prints the manual steps and runs nothing; the existing change-order tests keep passing. Do NOT touch tools/swarm.mjs, the tools/swarm folder, package files or .github. Run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test --test-timeout=60000 tests/change-order-auto-split.test.mjs tests/scope-split-repair-loop.test.mjs tests/split-repair.test.mjs tests/scope-commands.test.mjs tests/change-orders*.test.mjs tests/scope-ingest-*.test.mjs` and `node tools/check-package.mjs`.
